name: SYN
source:
Seven days ago, the Silver Treader rose from a classified hadopelagic trench in the Pacific Ocean.  Painted on it was the blood of the three scientists that were cradled in the submarine. Their bodies were nowhere to be found.

Six days ago, the Caspian Cell, armed with the blessings of science, disembarked into the trench.

Five days ago, it emerged with a catch.

Four hours ago, everyone in the facility was reclaimed by the sea.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/syn]itch.io[/url]]
